name: regression: report stays inside the progress window
description: Pins the bug where report() fell back to the global nearest segment when no projection was in the progress window, jumping about 13.4 km.

steps.why: First fix projects 100 m east on the 7,250 m outbound leg.

At x=1,000 m, the outbound projection is progress 1,000 and the return projection is 7,250 + 20 + (7,250 − 1,000) = 13,520 m; both are outside [50, 225]. The old empty-window fallback picks the nearer return branch (offset 0) and accepts 13,520 m, a 13,420 m jump from 100. The current behind search finds no candidate behind 100, and its global fallback sees an on-route forward candidate but returns the current reading, holding at 100 m.
